balls.text: what a way to finish the innings, he bludgeons a full toss outside off into the crowd again, Bravo has played a gem of an innings here, he was 7 off 7 but ended up on 43 off 18 balls
over Dwayne Bravo's head, does not know what to do and moves away at the last moment, but a no ball has been called as it was a second bouncer for the over
pulls a short of a length delivery to mid wicket, go through for a comfortable two
wide outside off, looks to make room, slips as he crunches it to wide of long off for two
back to back sixes again, picks a short delivery and comes off the toe end off the bat this time, but has enough power to clear the long on fence
full toss, that was a freebie on offer, mauls it over deep mid wicket for another massive six
short of a length, swings and misses
full toss, driven to wide long on, fielder runs to his right and stops it cleanly
yorker length, digs it out and off goes the ball to deep cover, tremendous bat speed
back to back sixes, this time he middles it cleanly, picks a length ball and deposits it into the crowd, 20 rows back
tries to flick it through square leg, but it takes a leading edge and off it goes sailing over wide long off, just clears the fence
slower delivery, short bouncer outside leg, Parthiv patel does not collect it cleanly, batsman go through for one

thats dropped by Sudhindra, full toss outside off, Dwayne Bravo slaps it straight back to the bowler who sticks his hand but the ball doesnt stick and the batsmen go through for a single as the ball deflects off to long off
short of a length, goes on his backfoot and plays it with soft hands to backward point
off cutter down the leg side, errs in line again, wide down the leg
crunches one through covers,
defends it solidly, Steyn keeping it straight and tight
sliding down the leg side, well wide and the batsmen go through for a run
bangs it in short, bounced the big Albie Morkel off his feet
GONE! Hit wicket! back of a length, goes on the back foot and tries to clip it to short fine leg but his left toe touches the off stump and the off comes the bail, that was a soft dismissal
slower ball, goes through the line and hoicks it over mid wicket, no timing in the shot but the batsmen have enough time to run two
outside off again, watches the ball cautiously and guides it to third man off his backfoot
outside off, waits for it, steers it to third man for a single
yorker length, digs it out to long on
Mammoth!! thats a biggie, pitched up, clears the front leg and clobbers it straight past the bowlers head. massive
short of a length, Jadeja tucks it off the toe end off the bat to fine leg for a two
low on the pads, flicks it to square leg for a comfortable single
2 in 2, this time he goes through mid wicket, gets the meat off the bat and sends it flying to the deep mid wicket
to deep cover, skips down the track and bashes it through cover, magnificent shot
dabs a length ball towards square leg
sprayed it outside off, slashes at it to sweeper cover, does not use his feet at all
bouncer, stays in the crease and tucks it to the on side
opens the face and guides it to down to third man
GONE this time! gets under the ball and looks to go over mid off, but gets the splice off the bat and hits it straight to Dan Harris
wide outside off, well wide
fuller length, turns it to square leg for two
short outside off, pokes at it off the toe end of the bat
crunches this to deep cover
short of a length, flashes at it and misses
goes down town again, humongous shot , blazes it over the sweeper cover region
short of a length, cut to backward point
that has been mauled! shimmies down the track and send it out like a bazooka, 102m the distance it has travelled
flat and full, picks it from outside off, clobbers it to the deep mid wicket for a four
full, comes forward  and bunts it to the on side
on the hips, tucks it to short fine leg for a single
angling in to the batsman, lets it go through to the wicket keeper
on the full, smashes it to short cover, White does splendidly to stop that
opens the face of the blade, dabs it to short fine leg
good length, no too much width offered, steers it to backward point
GONE!! caught at backward point!! short outside off, makes room and slices it over point, he was eyeing that region over deep point but does not connect it well and it goes straight to Chipli !
on the legs, pulls it towards the mid wicket but no tjming behind that shot
well outside off, digs it on to the off side, scamper for a tight single!
slower one, stays in the crease and punches it to the man at long off
short again, Badri tries to scoop it over the wicket keeper but misses it
short outside off, he gets onto it in a flash and heaves it to deep midwicket, stupendous
slightly short on the pads, swivels across, hits it on the pads and rolls over
on good length, Badri shuffles across and knocks it to deep square leg for a one
yorker length, opens the face and drives it to deep cover
opens the face and runs it down to backward square leg for a tight two, a good flat throw from Steyn from the deep
outside off, carves it straight to the fielder at point
in the slot asking to be hit, Badri pierces the gap between mid on and mid wicket, well done
on the pads, flicks it to deep mid wicket
wide outside off, makes room and steers it to third man for a one
sprayed it down the leg side, quite wide
uppish delivery, gets behind the line and punches it to cover
outside off again, drives it to wide of third man and hop over for a single
well bowled at a deceiving pace outside off, Jadeja tries to play it in front of square but misses
watches the delivery till the end, bunts it down to third man for a one
makes room and charges down the track, drives it wide of the man at mid off
short outside off, pulls it to short mid wicket for no run
short of a length, Badrinath climbs on to it in a flash and slashes it high over the point fielder, third man dives but cant avoid the ball from going to the fence
back of a length, dabs it off his back foot to mid wicket
opens the blade and guides it to third man
wide outside off, he's losing his line here
on the legs, tucks it to midwicket for a single
short outside leg, good bounce, batsman watches it go through
THAT's OUT!! caught at long on!! length deliver, should have clubbed it into the crowd but does not get his timing right, straight down the throat of Christian at long on
on the off, tries to defend but the ball drops it close to the stumps
opens the face and smears it to backward point
similar length, defends it back
floating length, rocks back and jams it back to the bowler
similar shot to the one played in the previous over, plays with the spin and clobbers it straight over the long off, Monstrous!!
on the middle and leg, turned across towards mid wicket
on the off, pushes it through to cover
slower one, dabs it to the on side
what a massive shot!! comes down the track, gets in the line of the delivery and bashes it high over the long off region, into the second tier this time!
comes forward and bunts it to the off side
closes the face and clips it to deep square leg again
on the pads, flicks it to deep square for a single
yorker length, digs it out to mid on and scamper home for a quick single, tight one
length outside off, misses an easy one
on good length, drives it to mid on,
GONE!! caught and Bowled!! does not middle the ball , tries to heave it over mid wicket but hits the toe end of the bat and loops high into the air and it has been gobbled up by the bowler himself!!
slightly short, swipes across the line and misses
rocks back, gets behind and smears it over the cover region, one bounce over the fence
one more, this time he clubs it high over the wide long off region, that has gone a mile, into the first tier!!
on the good length, rocks back and cannons it high over the deep mid wicket area, that's into the crowd
Banged in short again, makes room and plays it deftly with soft hands, races away to the third man boundary
sees Faf coming down and bangs it in short, straight to Dhoni behind the stumps
shortish delivery, shimmies down the pitch and hoicks it over mid on, fielder at mid on tries to get into the line of the delivery but to no avail
good length, plants his foot forward and shows the full face of the bat
fuller length, Faf flicks it wide of mid off, one bounce to the man at mid off
shuffles slightly and dabs it on the on side
on the off, goes off the inside edge of the bat to deep square leg
outside off, cuts it to wide third man
slighly outside off, stays in the crease and pushes it to extra cover
on the pads, flicks it to fine leg off his hips for an easy single
width offered, carves it to the fielder at third man, go through one run
Faf charges down the track and looks to heave it over the bowler's head but misses it, straight to the keeper
moves across to a delivery pitched outside off, hits him low on his pads and rolls to the slip cordon
on the leg stump, flicks it off his pads to square leg for one run
outside off, solidly defends it to the off side, no run
outside off, width offered, drives it elegantly wide of point, times it to perfection!!
brilliant bowling!! short one, batsman had no clue watsoever, goes through to the wicketkeeper
shortish delivery, clips it deftly to the wide of slips to wide third man
half volley in the slot, leans into it and smears it through the cover region, exquisite timing!
well outside off, swinging, batsman steers it to wide third man for an easy single
outside off, shapes away and chips it to point
fires it on good length, gets behind and chops it on to the off side
full on the middle, comes forward and shows the full face of the bat
GONE!! Bowled!! peach of a delivery, pitches on the middle and turns away, hits the pads and clips the top of off stump, Murali Vijay was caught off guard
outside off, chops it on to the pitch, goes behind the stumps
on the full, digs it out right in the nick of time
turning away from the right hander, pushes it to cover
on the middle and leg, drives it to wide long on for an easy couple

caught by Albie Morkel! It's all over here, Ankit Sharma makes room but Bollinger follows him and Ankit sharma plays it on the up and lofts it high but does not get enough elevation and Albie Morkel takes an easy catch running to his back at mid off
LBW! fires it on the middle stump, Steyn tries to push it back to the bowler but does not get bat onto the ball, thumps on his pads, caught plumb in front, Jadeja gets a five-for
on the legs, Ankit sharma goes onto his back foot and pulls it to deep backward square leg
flat and quicker, cuts it to point
quicker through the air, squeezes it to short mid wicket
outside off, goes back and turns it away to backward square
on the middle and off, defends it to the on side
outside off, Steyn stays in the crease and drives through to long on
wide outside off, Ankit sharma slaps it to deep cover for a single
similar shot, picks up a half volley, plays with the spin and clubs it over deep mid wicket again for a monstrous hit
short of a length, gives room and has all the time in the world to clobber it over deep mid wicket for a six
fuller length, driven down to the long off
on the legs, driven down to long on for a one
looks to drive, ball races away to third man off a thick outside edge, Vijay does well to stop it from reaching the fence
flighted outside off, Steyn looks to drive and misses, Dhoni flips the bails off but Steyn is well in
pushes quicker through the air, inside edge on to the pads
GONE, Stumped! Jadeja gets it spin away, Ravi Teja was into his shot a tad early and is dragged out of his crease and Dhoni does the rest
GONE, caught by Raina! tossed up on middle, looks to smash it high over deep cover but Raina takes an easy catch in the deep
Tossed up outside off, bunts it to short cover, Dhoni picks it and has a shy at the stumps and an overthrow fetches the batsmen a run
GONE, caught by Dwayne Bravo at deep midwicket, Christian goes for the heave and misses the slog sweep, a regulation catch to Bravo in the deep
tossed up on stumps, Gony gets a thick outside edge and off it flies to Badri at first slip who fluffs a tough chance
Gony goes for the heave and misses
flighted outside off, Christian gets a thick outside edge and the ball falls short of Ashwin
tossed up, drives it to long on
looks to pull over mid wicket but manages to squeeze it to mid wicket
slower one, dabs it but no run
flat outside off, Gony punches it to cover
GONE, Bowled! the ball keeps low, Chipli looks to steer it to third man but misses it and the ball crashes into the off stump
pushes it quicker through the air, pushes it back to the bowler
tossed up, uses his feet well, stands tall and thrashes it high over sweeper cover for a six
whips it off his pads to deep mid wicket for a single
floating on the leg, punches it to long on
on the middle, turned away to square leg

GONE, Caught at long off, a touch slower from Jakati, White makes room again and tries to emulate Dwayne Bravo who had clobbered back to back sixes earlier in the innings but hits it straight to Raina at long off
White gives room and clobbers it with a straight bat over the long off region for a massive six, DC have got to move on here
flat and crunched it to sweeper cover for a single
outside off, rocks back and steers it to through the covers
floating on the off stump, punches it to short cover
on the legs, driven to mid on
GONE, Bowled! Parthiv goes for the slog sweep but gets a thick inside edge and the ball rolls onto his stumps
Parthiv comes forward and takes it on the full and digs it out to the off side
short and wide, rocks back and pulls it over the deep square leg fence, stupendous shot
full and slower delivery, Parthiv digs it out to cover and go through for a single
slower delivery outside off, opens the face and tucks it to square leg
sprayed it down the leg side, White waits for it and glances it down to the fine leg fence
outside off, stays back and pushes it to cover
short of a length, White makes room and flat bats it past the bowler straight to the boundary
back of a length, White makes room but chops it onto the pitch back to the bowler
White pushes it to mid on as Raina follows him with a skidder
tossed up, Parthiv tucks it to backward square leg
skids it through, stays in the crease and slaps it to long off
go through for a single as Raina pushes it through the air
flatter, White pierces the gap between mid wicket and long on
flicked to mid wicket, played with soft hands, looks for two but White says 'no' and wisely so
pitched on legs, clips it to deep square leg
outside off, uses the pace and upper cuts it to the third man boundary
on the middle, hits the pads and rolls on to the off side where Dhoni picks the ball and has a shy at the stumps
on the pads, jams it back to the bowler
on the legs, whips it in a flash to the deep mid wicket, good work from the fielder in the deep
good length on the middle and off, stays low, White defends it to short cover
on the legs, flicks it to deep square leg
outside off, rocks back and punches it to sweeper cover
on the off, flicks it to mid wicket for a single
flat on the middle, knocks it to long off for a single
GONE! caught by Dwayne Bravo at deep mid wicket, pitched up, Dhawan goes for the slog sweep over mid wicket but picks up Bravo in the deep
on the leg stump, thumps on his pads and goes on to the off side
outside off, steers it to wide third man
half volley, picks it from off side and thrashes it to the deep square leg boundary
thumps off his pads on to the on side, batsmen go through for a single
outside off, opens the face and lofts it gently over the deep cover region, Dwayne puts in a valiant effort but in vain
on the middle and leg, tucks it to the on side
fuller in  length, Parthiv whips it to mid wicket
Dhawan plants his front foot forward and loops it over extra cover, did not time it well but go through for an easy two
tossed up on the off, comes a touch forward and defends it
slightly short, goes for a pre-determined sweep but doesnt connect it
spinning away, zips past the outside edge as Dhawan tries to defend
flat, slices it to backward point for a single
flighted delivery, Parthiv pushes it to point
GONE, caught by Dhoni, Harris looks to clobber it high over the bowler and that goes as high as Burj Dubai but not the distance and Dhoni gets under it and takes an easy catch
fuller outside off, clubs it to vijay who does not stop it cleanly and the ball rolls away from him to the mid off boundary
short and wide outside off, carves it over the man at point towards third man boundary
pitched up, drills it back to the bowler
on the hips, taps it to backward square leg for an easy single
wide again down the leg side
short and wide down the leg side
fuller length, Dhawan looks to drive it past the bowler but misses it
tossed up on the off, Dhawan clips it past mid wicket
short and spins, goes behind and pulls it but finds deep square leg
goes forward and defends to the off side
thick outside edge off the face of his bat towards wide of first slip, Jadeja does well to keep it to a single
tossed up on middle, Harris dabs it to square leg
inswinging delivery, stays back and punches it to long off for a run
similar line, on the pads, Dhawan flicks it off his pads to deep square leg
back to back fours, angling onto the pads, Dhawan whips it past square leg for another four
good length, thick outside edge off the bottom of the bat, races away to the right of Dhoni who was moving to his right
short on the hips again, taps it on to the leg side
outside off, stays in the crease and steers it fine of Bollinger who is placed slightly wide off third man
short, tucks it off his hips to short fine leg
wide down the leg side, veers it down
quite a bit of turn on offer, fielders appeal for a catch that came off his pads straight to the first slip fielder, not out says the umpire
pushed through again, defends it back
spins into Dan Harris, chops onto his pads and onto the pitch
pushes it through, a faster delivery outside off
outside off, comes off the toe end of his bat
starts off with a four, a little width on offer, slashes at it to deep point boundary
